qQmSeJ4eea6s.text: To solve the problem, here are the key entities to search in Wikipedia:

jKnhPVHyLGLa.text: - @conservation of mass@: This concept is essential in understanding that the flow rate (mass per unit time) remains constant throughout the pipe

RyyZnyh4U4VZ.text: - @Areal flow rate formula@: The formula for the areal flow rate (Q) should be  Q = Av, where A is the cross-sectional area and v is the flow speed

3uR5BiZ9ihak.text: - @Cross-sectional area of a circle@: The formula for the cross-sectional area (A) of a circle is A = πr^2, where r is the radius of the circle

dsNWxTryeAUy.text: - @Relation between diameter and radius@: The diameter of the pipe is given, but the radius is required for the cross-sectional area calculation

rhxo28miSMYD.text: You can also search for @poiseuille flow@ or @laminar flow@ if you want to read up on the flow characteristics in a pipe with a circular cross-section
